title: Exact solution of the Seven-Vertex Model on a dynamical lattice
summary: We give the complete solution of the one-parameter deformation of the six-vertex model on dynamical lattice introduced in [1] and dubbed gravitational seven-vertex model. The statistical model in question is mapped to a gas of self- and mutually avoiding loops on dynamical triangulations, with a temperature coupling controlling the volume not occupied by loops. The phase diagram is characterised by massive, dilute and dense critical phases, similarly to the gravitational O(n) loop model.
